verdict.rationale: The evidence shows a v2 API reference rendered under /openapi/reference/v2/ paths, which suggests it is generated from an OpenAPI spec. No evidence item documents a downloadable machine-readable spec file, and probes of the standard paths (openapi.json, swagger.json, api/openapi.json, .well-known/openapi.json) all returned 404. A human-readable reference alone is an adjacent feature, not the requested download.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
